scope: Conservative country-level reference policies for the 48 destination seeds. This is not an entry admissibility decision.
limitations: Regime-level rules now have official-source references for all 21 foreign countries. Unknown numeric stay limits remain null. This does not establish full admission requirements or the remaining permitted stay. Some KDMID pages were available only as indexed official text (30 September 2026 snapshot) while direct requests returned maintenance; see country conditions.
Visa exemption does not guarantee admission or remove passport, insurance, declaration, proof-of-funds and other entry requirements.
Null day limits and dates mean not established by this snapshot, never unlimited stay.
Previous travel history, dual nationality, special passports, work/study/residence, transit and travel with animals are outside this snapshot.
